gloss: beginning of the week; start of the new week

definitions.gloss: beginning of the week; start of the new week (typically Monday)
definitions.explanation: The start of the work week, usually Monday. Commonly used in business and news contexts to refer to the first business day after the weekend.

examples.japanese: {週明|しゅうあ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a meeting at the start of next week.

examples.japanese: {週明|しゅうあ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'll reply on Monday at the start of the week.

examples.japanese: {週明|しゅうあ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{株式|かぶしき}→株式：04772_kabushiki⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な⟦{値上|ねあ}がり→値上がり：11538_neagari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The stock market opened sharply higher at the start of the week.

notes:
USAGE:
{週明|しゅうあ}け is a practical business and media term. It typically means Monday, but after a long holiday it can refer to the first business day back. It follows the same pattern as other ～⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧ words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {週明|しゅうあ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (at the beginning of the week)
- {週明|しゅうあ}け⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from the start of the week)
- {週明|しゅうあ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧ (Monday, the start of the week)
